--- title: "Command Line Tool" description: "Access and manage your database from a terminal with openvireo-kdbx." weight: 130 icon: "fa-terminal" anchor: "_command_line_tool" sections: [] ---

OpenVireo comes with the command line tool openvireo-kdbx to access, view, and manipulate your database directly from a terminal window. The tool is documented through a separate man page, which can be shown using man openvireo-kdbx, or through the on-demand help using openvireo-kdbx [command] -h. An online version of the man page is available on GitHub. It works on local database files; for vaults stored in an OpenVireo account, use the ov command line tool from the OpenVireo SDK.
